name: capture-readiness
goal: Capture rendered images and ready audio without waiting for unrelated background network activity; preserve failed-media and exact-source checks.

evidence: Continuous background requests must not block screenshots after fonts and images render. Broken images remain rejected. Audio assertions wait for the exact current source rather than sampling before metadata loads.

Real browser regression times out on networkidle despite the image being loaded; broken-image rejection passes. CI audio regression observed empty currentSrc. Red log: /tmp/harness-capture-readiness-red-20261017.log.

Wait for DOM readiness, fonts and decoded images instead of background network silence. Preserve nonzero dimensions and failed-image refusal. Poll the audio source before checking its exact served address.

Two unchanged readiness regressions and both real five-check browser suites pass. Desktop/tablet/mobile captures, audio playback, served bytes and wrong-build rejection all pass; original assertions retained.
